cat lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx next.config.ts && git diff package.json
ls node_modules/.bin/next >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install --silent; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

grep -o '

[^<]*

' .next/server/app/product.html; grep -o 'Loading inventory[^<]*' .next/server/app/product.html; echo; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
